task_title: Restore all Floor 1 release sweep victories

plan_review.notes: Review approved the no-duplicate-first approach. Adopted exact Actions config extraction, verification-only scope for unrelated historical cases, and ledger-before-edit ordering. Actions logs then proved four distinct authoritative failures, so scope is limited to those four.

independent_grade.notes: The change correctly addresses the safe-room doorway flicker bug that was resetting NPC-approach threat-tracking. The updated logic properly gates the threat-clear logic to require the player to not be in a safe room, allowing the branch to fall through and preserve the no-progress counter during a flicker frame where weapons are disabled. The rollback of the outer condition to an unconditional else is fully correct, as a genuinely exited gate should reset the tracker without leaving a stale bypass latched. The regression tests added are thorough and explicitly cover the flicker frame edge case.
